title: Sekiro Costs You $2 an Hour. Worth It?
caption:
Sekiro is $59.99 on Steam and takes about 30 hours to beat (HowLongToBeat averages, main story): $2 an hour. A $12 movie ticket for 2 hours is $6 an hour. Go 100% (about 70 hours) and it drops to 86¢ an hour. Our own math, and your deaths don't count as extra hours... or do they?
Which game should we price next?

Sources: Steam store (US price), HowLongToBeat averages
ig_first_line: Send this to the friend who died 300 times to Genichiro. Sekiro costs $2 an hour.
